description.value: W.C. Blair Recreation Centre is a large municipal recreation facility operated by the Township of Langley, featuring a free-form wave pool with six 25-metre lanes, a climbing wall, spray lagoon, sauna, steam room, and whirlpool. The centre offers a full range of fitness amenities including cardio and weight rooms alongside extensive aquatic programming. Touring cyclists would find useful services here including change rooms, showers, and quarter-operated lockers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The W.C. Blair Recreation Centre website clearly confirms the address (22200 Fraser Highway, Langley, BC V3A 3T2) and provides a phone number (604-533-6170) absent from OSM. The amenities section explicitly lists washrooms on deck and in change rooms, and a change room with a hand-held shower head under accessibility features. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, café, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; website provides 604-533-6170 — used website value.
Category assigned as 'Attractions' but this is a municipal community recreation centre, not a tourist attraction.
Access to showers and lockers likely requires paid admission; 'Water without admission' and 'Showers (drop-in or fee)' could not be confirmed as freely accessible without paying entry.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a municipal community recreation centre with cyclist-useful amenities (washrooms, showers, lockers), but it is not a tourism attraction and likely requires paid admission to access most facilities. The 'Attractions' category assignment is incorrect, and it is unclear whether any amenities are accessible to non-paying visitors.
